project.name: CardZone
project.concept: A deckbuilding game where players start with a simple 10-card deck and improve it during play, designed to also work as a physical tabletop game: minimal state upkeep and no random effects.
project.unique_selling_point: A deterministic deckbuilder with no shuffling luck that plays the same on the web and on a table.

development_rules: Physical-playable: every rule must be resolvable by hand with minimal bookkeeping
No random effects (no shuffles, dice or random draws)

risks.mitigation: Strict feature freeze after design phase
